name: Bestiary
description: Canonical UESP taxonomy of creatures, beasts, undead, and daedric entities across Tamriel

entries.content:
MAMMALS OF TAMRIEL (Canines, Rodents, Felines):
• Wolves & Snow Wolves: Pack predators common to the boreal pine forests and arctic wastes of Skyrim and High Rock. Alpha wolves coordinate swift flanking strikes, circling prey in blinding snowstorms.
• Giant Rats: Ubiquitous scavengers infesting dungeon cellars, sewers, and ancient tombs. Though individually fragile, they attack in rabid swarms and transmit Red Fever and swamp rot.
• Senche-Raht: Colossal quadrupedal Khajiit morphs native to Elsweyr's savanna and jungle heartlands. Formidable apex predators with bone-crushing jaws and acute predatory intelligence.

REPTILES & AVIAN PREDATORS OF TAMRIEL:
• Lizardmen: Primitive, semi-aquatic reptilian humanoids inhabiting the dense bayous of Black Marsh and tropical marshlands. Armed with serrated spears and tough scaly hide.
• Cliff Racers: Aggressive, leathery-winged avian predators dominating the skies and ash barrens of Morrowind and Red Mountain. They descend in relentless screeching dives, attacking in numbers.
• Dune Rippers: Massive carnivorous burrowers native to the scorching wastes of Hammerfell and the Alik'r Desert. They surface from beneath the sands in sudden subterranean ambushes.

INVERTEBRATES & ARTHROPODS OF TAMRIEL:
• Giant Spiders: Chitinous hunters spinning webbed labyrinths in deep caverns and crypts. Their mandibles inject paralyzing neurotoxin that drains agility and vitality.
• Nix-Hounds: Carnivorous eight-legged arthropods native to Morrowind. They hunt in ashland packs, using tubular proboscises to drain stamina and bodily fluids.
• Dreugh & Land Dreugh: Ancient armored aquatic abominations inhabiting coastal reefs and estuaries. Wielding crushing chitinous pincer-claws, they undergo a terrestrial metamorphosis during their annual karvinasim cycle.

UNDEAD & VAMPIRES OF TAMRIEL:
• Corporeal Undead (Skeletons, Zombies, Ghouls, Draugr, Ayleid Wights): Reanimated corpses bound by profane necromancy or ancient curses. Immune to poison, disease, and paralysis. Vulnerable to blunt crushing force and silver.
• Incorporeal Undead (Wraiths, Ghosts, Spectres): Ethereal phantoms of malevolent souls. Immune to normal iron/steel weapons; can ONLY be harmed by Silver, Elven, Dwarven, Mithril, Adamantium, Ebony, or Magic spells. They emit an aura of freezing dread that saps willpower.
• Vampires & Vampire Lords: Immortal predators cursed by Molag Bal. Masters of blood magic, illusion, and superhuman strength. Highly resistant to physical trauma, vulnerable to sunlight, fire, and sacred magic.
• Liches & Nether Liches: Supreme sorcerers who severed their souls into phylacteries. Capable of unleashing catastrophic destruction magic and commanding legionnaires of the dead.

DAEDRA & OBLIVION ENTITIES:
• Elemental Atronachs (Fire, Frost, Storm): Unaligned lesser daedra formed of pure elemental energy and planar mineral. Immune to mundane weapons, poison, paralysis, and their native element. They detonate violently upon destruction.
• Hellhounds: Demonic fiery canines servant to Mehrunes Dagon. They breathe jets of molten flame and ignite foes in close melee.
• Winged Twilights & Homunculi: Bat-winged daedric messengers servant to Azura and Nocturnal. Agile aerial skirmishers armed with razor talons and natural spell absorption.
• Clannfears: Beaked, bipedal saurian daedra boasting armored bone crests. They charge with ferocious momentum, tearing through plate armor.

MAGICAL HYBRIDS & MONSTROUS BEASTS:
• Trolls & Frost Trolls: Savage, three-eyed ape-like carnivores inhabiting caves and mountains. Renowned for miraculous flesh regeneration; wounds close instantly unless cauterized with Fire spells or burning torches.
• Minotaurs: Massive bull-headed humanoids boasting enormous muscle and natural armor. Once honored descendants of Morihaus and Alessia, now feral guardians of labyrinthine ruins wielding giant clubs and warhammers.
• Medusas: Cursed serpentine monstrosities dwelling in subterranean grottos. Their petrifying gaze freezes victims into solid stone while their poisoned arrows strike at range.
• Harpies: Ravenous bird-women nesting in cliffside crags throughout High Rock and Hammerfell. They emit piercing sonic shrieks to disorient travelers before diving to scavenge.

GOLEMS & MAGICAL CONSTRUCTS:
• Stone & Iron Golems: Colossal artificial automata sculpted from bedrock, obsidian, or enchanted metals and given artificial life through high-tier binding magic. Possess monumental strength, extreme natural damage resistance, and total immunity to bleeding, disease, poison, paralysis, and mind magic.

NATURE SPIRITS & FAERIES:
• Spriggans: Guardians of pristine forests, glades, and sacred groves in Valenwood and High Rock. Formed of living wood, vines, and sap, they heal wounds rapidly and command local wildlife. Highly susceptible to Fire and axe cleaves.
• Faeries & Nymphs: Enigmatic nature spirits speaking ancient tongues. Playful or hostile tricksters wielding nature illusions and charm magic.

WEREBEASTS & LYCANTHROPY:
• Werewolves & Wereboars: Mortals afflicted with the curse of Hircine (Sanies Lupinus). In beast form, they gain supernatural speed, night vision, and devastating claw attacks. Highly resistant to physical trauma, vulnerable only to Silver weaponry and wolfsbane remedies.
